description: This file is a shell script used for testing the gitweb web interface functions in a standalone environment. It executes various git commands to set up repository states and runs the gitweb script with different parameters to verify its output and behavior in different scenarios, including commits, diff views, tags, logs, encoding, configuration, search, and more.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, running the provided commands and checking for successful execution.

methods.name: gitweb_run
methods.description: Executes the gitweb script with specific parameters to generate web interface output for testing.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: Configures environment or repository variables for testing purposes.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Sets commands to run after the current test completes, typically for cleanup or restoring state.

methods.name: test_might_fail
methods.description: Executes commands that are expected to sometimes fail, used for testing error handling scenarios.

methods.name: test_ln_s_add
methods.description: Creates symbolic links as part of test setup.
